title: Expand AI testing-plan routing to cover protocol, adapter, release, and security changes
spec: The AI helper CLI's testing-plan command maps a single change type to required test evidence, but real work mixes types. Expand it so (1) changes touching protocol schemas, adapters, release tooling, and security-sensitive files each map to their own required evidence and commands (for example protocol changes require contract-test evidence; security changes require a security review note), (2) the command accepts multiple change types at once via a --changes flag with a comma-separated list (for example --changes web,security) and produces one combined plan covering every listed type's evidence, and (3) change-type inference from file paths recognizes those new patterns. Update the CLI self-check to cover the new routes.
